· Position vs SMA100 ($145.56)/SMA200 ($134.42): indicates weak long-term trend.
· 52-week position (31.9%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (30.8→27.2): sustained oversold condition, downward pressure maintained.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-2.4635→-2.4635): weak momentum holding, weak trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $115.07): approaching lower band, band width at 31.26% expansion.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($110.60): near current price, testing support.
· Swing resistance ($112.64): resistance level for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low continuation): confirms strengthening downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.57x): increased confidence in movement, confirmed selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): potential for short-term bounce due to extreme RSI oversold and high volume, but trend reversal unconfirmed; maintain wait-and-see stance.
